plugins.description: Your GitLab Review Requests in Orca: a count in the status bar, a panel, and review workspaces.

plugins.description: Keeps each Linked Workspace's Board Column in step with its Linear ticket, and writes your drags into Writable Columns back to Linear.
Copies your gitignored local files (agent config, every .env file, anything you list as a glob) into every new worktree, before the agent starts.
